daily.title: France-Turquie : le résumé de la qualification laborieuse des Bleus en quarts de finale de la Ligue des nations de football
daily.summary: L’équipe de France de football a dominé la Turquie (2-1), dimanche à Bordeaux, pour s’adjuger la première place du groupe A. Les Bleus connaîtront leurs adversaires en quarts de finale, vendredi, lors du tirage au sort à Nyon (Suisse).

daily.title: Kroupi on target as France beat Turkey to reach Nations League quarters
daily.summary: Eli Junior Kroupi scored his maiden goal for France as Les Bleus beat Turkey 2-1 in Bordeaux on Sunday to top their group with 13 points and qualify for the quarter-finals of the Nations League. World Cup winners Spain, who lost at home against England, are among their potential opponents in the last eight.

daily.title: Nearly 2,200 migrants reach Spain's Canary Islands in two days
daily.summary: Nearly 2,200 migrants have reached the Canary Islands over the past two days, Spain’s coastguard said Sunday, continuing a recent surge of arrivals from West African countries to the Spanish archipelago, where the authorities declared a migration emergency earlier this week.
